answer: Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. The echo of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, released only after three unrelated confirmations, idle agents bleed standing. A mirror of per-task receipts records who did what, and the knoll of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it.
